decisions.reason: The church-motif music box extends the firm's established seasonal line with little added cost, and industry turnover is growing, so results likely meet aspirations and no problemistic search is triggered after only one season.
Nativity stables are a core, evergreen item in the firm's in-house craft range, so the product fits existing capabilities and customer expectations and gives no reason to cut it.

The modern incense smoker supports the stated move toward contemporary design, and the firm's slack from a growing market and its own workshops lets it carry the product while its results are still uncertain.
